claims.statement: A single shared policy file test-utils/network-policy.json (schema epic128-test-network-policy/v1) defines the test network allowlist (loopback plus docker service hosts, http/https/ws/wss, no Unix sockets) and test-utils/outbound-network-policy.ts enforces it via assertAllowedTestUrl/assertAllowedSocketHost, throwing ERR_TEST_NETWORK_DENIED on violations; both Vitest and Playwright guards read the same file.

The current accepted full Vitest baseline (CLAUDE.md accepted-baselines table, `npm test -- --run`) is ≥ 19,415 passing / 0 failed. That value is the 19,118 floor set by Story 174.2-FE (2026-08-31) — itself an exact −756 tests / −22 files from 19,874/1,256 by deletion of 65 proven-dead test files (import-closure proved, no live test deleted) — plus +237 tests from the 174.3 window, +8 contract tests from 174.4, and +52 redact-suite tests from debt-FE-D9. Earlier per-story peaks such as 19,874 are historical; the baseline is not a substitute for fresh per-story validation, and a story that legitimately moves it must update the table in the same PR.

Story 173.2 delivered two dedicated backfill-admin e2e specs under e2e/settings/: backfill-admin.spec.ts pins the deterministic Owner shell at /settings/backfill against a stubbed `**/v1/admin/backfill/status` (per-cabinet dual-pipeline reports/analytics status, progress with ETA, lastError, mutating-guarded interactions), and backfill-a11y.spec.ts pins WCAG 2.1 AA axe scans over a dense eight-cabinet mixed-status fixture (including a long RU cabinet name proving wrap without horizontal overflow), keyboard/dialog focus, and 320–1440px layout cases using the Story 162.8 bounded-settle terminal pattern.

The dedicated shipments e2e package lives under e2e/shipments/ (list and detail specs carry Epic 77-FE Story 77.2 e2e artifact headers; the package was restored during the Stories 173.8/173.9 shipments migration): shipments-list.spec.ts drives /shipments via a switchable scenario fixture (default/empty/error/gated-pending) covering status filtering, pagination, the create-shipment dialog, and empty/error states; shipments-detail.spec.ts stubs `**/v1/shipments/story-173-9-detail` to cover the header, pallet accordion, box-line allocation table (calculated vs pending lines), draft-vs-confirmed actions, and an axe scan. Sibling specs cover shipments a11y/lifecycle, and e2e/supplies/ mirrors the same list/detail/lifecycle/a11y shape.

Telegram notification e2e coverage lives only in e2e/telegram-notifications.spec.ts (binding status with bound/telegram_user_id/binding_expires_at, preferences, quiet hours, and success/failure/pending mutation modes via route stubs with axe scans); the former duplicate at tests/e2e/telegram-notifications.spec.ts is absent from the current tree, while src/test/playwright-static-boundary.ts still scans the `tests/e2e/` path prefix defensively.

e2e/settings-pages.spec.ts pins the shared settings shell across cabinet/tariffs/notifications/tax/expenses/backfill routes: the exact seven-item ordered navigation (Обзор, Кабинет, Уведомления, Налоги, Тарифы, Расходы, Импорт) with exactly one visible `aria-current="page"` per route, compact-Sheet keyboard focus containment, light/dark theming via localStorage.theme with reload, horizontal-overflow checks, and zero-violation per-page axe scans (wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag22aa).

Current local validation is the README.md Local validation command list (type-check, lint, `npm test -- --run`, test:privacy, test:coverage, check:privacy, format:check, build) plus the active story plan; there is no mandatory CI merge gate, and development/validation are local-only (frontend :3100, backend :3000). scripts/story-128-10/ is immutable historical, branch-bound Story 128.10 evidence tied to the former feat/epic-128-10-frontend-verification-foundation branch and must not be treated as a current validation entry point.

The openwiki-update.yml workflow protects a generated/protected boundary: after generation it restores .github/workflows/openwiki-update.yml, every AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md to their HEAD versions; it stages only `git add -A -- openwiki/ ':(top,exclude)openwiki/INSTRUCTIONS.md'` and refuses to commit anything staged outside openwiki/, any unexpected unstaged/untracked/ignored file; checkout uses persist-credentials: false.

Scheduled openwiki runs on main commit, then create and push a unique automation branch `automation/openwiki-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}-${GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT}` (attempt included so failed-publication reruns use a fresh branch) via a temporary x-access-token remote URL restored through an EXIT trap, and open a PR against main via the GitHub REST API with curl — no gh CLI, no force-push, no direct push to main, no auto-merge. Manual dispatches must target a non-main branch ref and push the generated commit back to that same branch; dispatch on main is rejected before checkout.

scripts/check-shadcn-ui-boundary.mjs (Story 174.2, no npm alias — invoke with `node scripts/…`) scans production src/**/*.{ts,tsx} (tests, __tests__, .d.ts, src/test excluded; relative-first enumeration) for LEGACY_PALETTE and CONTEXTUAL_HEX violations using the superset regex canon, groups them per route, totals them, and ratchets against the single-integer baseline scripts/.shadcn-ui-boundary-baseline.txt (459, lowered from the 174.2 birth value 523 by 174.4's live re-run): exit 0 at or below baseline, exit 1 only on increase, and any decrease must lower the baseline in the same commit. Suppression is only via the exported BOUNDARY_EXCEPTIONS map (3 files — the C5 waterfall categorical hex and two historical `#7C3AED` chart marks; the former F-10 WCAG-contrast exception was lifted 2026-09-02), each entry carrying an owner/debt ID and mirrored 1:1 in the classification manifest; the script runs its 10-case node:test self-suite first and fails fast if it fails.

scripts/check-shadcn-migration-parity.mjs (Story 174.1) is a dependency-free, filesystem-only schema-v3 parity validator over the BMAD story artifact, the master OMX plan, and the 76-row route ledger that proves 94 BMAD stories = 94 OMX plans and 76 source routes = 76 ledger rows = 76 unique owners with linked implementation artifacts; it runs a deterministic 33-case node:test mutation self-suite (scripts/__tests__/check-shadcn-migration-parity.test.mjs) before validating the canonical corpus and emits one machine-readable report plus one human summary per run. Both script self-suites are excluded from the Vitest run in vitest.config.ts because they are node:test-only surfaces.

The Playwright static boundary's APPROVED_RUNTIME_MODULES/SELF_TEST_MODULES allowlist in src/test/playwright-static-boundary.ts not only covers the guard fixtures, playwright.config.ts, and boundary self-tests, but also whitelists scripts/check-privacy-console.test.mjs and scripts/__tests__/check-shadcn-migration-parity.test.mjs — the two node:test self-suites that legitimately need node:child_process (the parity entry added as the Story 174.2 carry-in fix).

e2e/sku-packaging-page.spec.ts (Story 173.11) provides the representative new-spec pattern for the guarded Playwright runtime: it imports test/expect from ./fixtures/network-test and installs exact-method/exact-query page.route fixtures (GET/POST /v1/sku-packaging, POST /v1/sku-packaging/bulk, DELETE /v1/sku-packaging/{nmId}, GET /v1/box-types) in beforeEach before navigation, with handlers that throw on any unexpected method/path/payload so a silently-missed stub cannot pass; it pins the exact single-upsert, bulk, and delete wire contracts, terminal role=status announcements, filter reset focus, keyboard validation with first-invalid focus, and 320/390px narrow-card layout without horizontal overflow.

e2e/support/story-174-3-runner-core.ts supplies the shared Story 174.3 runner primitives used by both the 76-route matrix spec and the real-browser-zoom spec: EXPECTED_ROUTE_COUNT = 76, applyTheme (localStorage theme + reload + .dark class regex), prepareSessionProfile (clears cookies and auth-storage keys so unauthenticated-onboarding routes render their own UI instead of redirecting to /dashboard), and assertSettledRoute, which polls the exact pathname (redirectors must settle on a declared final route), requires a settled readyState with zero Next.js error markers and exactly one visible h1, rejects generic error/not-found shells, and verifies the route's identity contract (exact static/materialized h1 text, backend-h1 landmark pattern, route-landmark accessible name, or redirector destination heading).

e2e/story-174-3-dedicated-route-evidence.spec.ts closes dedicated route-evidence gaps: settled-route plus exact-h1 assertions for /analytics/brand-share, /analytics/buyout, and /orders/fbo, and deterministic coverage of the dynamic /analytics/models/[id]/evaluations/sku-accuracy route via an exact-method/exact-query GET /v1/ai/evaluations/sku-accuracy?modelId=… stub — pinned table caption, ordered rows with localized percentages, aria-sort ascending/descending toggling, viewport containment at 1280 and 390 px, and Enter-driven drill-in to ?nmId=… with exact detail text.

scripts/run-story-174-3-real-browser-zoom.mjs is a macOS-only orchestrator that pins Node v24.18.0 and npm 11.11.0 (via STORY_174_3_NPM_CLI), spawns the headed single-worker Playwright zoom spec with STORY_174_3_REAL_BROWSER_ZOOM=1 and a private ready-file, then finds the single headed Chromium process by descendant-PID walk and applies real browser UI zoom via osascript (Cmd+0 reset plus five Cmd+Plus presses). The spec (e2e/story-174-3-real-browser-zoom.spec.ts) is skipped without that env pair and proves the zoom is genuine browser UI zoom, not a CSS proxy: root zoom must stay 1|normal, devicePixelRatio must at least double, innerWidth must shrink to ≤ baseline/1.9; at that zoom all 76 routes must keep scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth + 2 with main inside the viewport in both themes, authenticated routes first and then unauthenticated-onboarding routes after session clearing.

scripts/run-story-174-3-state-evidence.mjs is the fail-closed Story 174.3 execution-manifest orchestrator: modes --owner-units/--owner-browsers/--dedicated-routes/--owners/--defaults/--all run the scenario sets declared in the e2e/fixtures/story-174-3/ fixture sources (extracted by scripts/lib/story-174-3-execution-requirements.mjs with per-source SHA-256 pinning) through Vitest JSON reports and the test:e2e:full Playwright wrapper, map every required scenario id to a recorded outcome, and throw on any missing scenario, non-passed result, or non-zero exit code before rewriting e2e/fixtures/story-174-3/execution-manifest.json (schemaVersion 1, deduplicated sorted entries with command/exitCode/startedAt/durationMs). The --defaults mode additionally requires prior full --owners coverage and passes assertMergeReadyEntries, which rejects duplicate, unexpected, missing, stale (sourceSha256/runner mismatch), or incomplete (non-passed/exit≠0) merge-ready entries.

The Story 174.3 fixture corpus under e2e/fixtures/story-174-3/ (~30 typed modules) feeds all 174.3 runners and contract tests: the 76-route registry (route-evidence/route-contracts/state-evidence), owner-state-evidence-{a,b,c}* families with exceptions and reconciliation, the table/chart/overlay inventories that verify production-file anchors at import time, surface-types, dedicated-route-scenarios, the immutable manual-evidence operator ledger, and the execution-manifest pair; the contract guarantees are enforced by the Vitest tests src/test/story-174-3-{manifest-reader,state-contract,surface-contract,manual-evidence-contract}.test.ts.

e2e/shadcn-migration-visual-accessibility.spec.ts is the consolidated Story 174.3 matrix runner: its first test is a meta-assertion that the 76-route registry, identities, and surface contracts are internally closed (table/chart/overlay expectedCount == surfaces, chart data-alternative associations constrained, conditional surfaces carry not-applicable-in-canonical-default rationales with owner-test or canonical-trigger verification, executed state evidence pinned by SHA-256 of its cited file plus a line number containing the scenario id), and it then runs the per-route theme × width matrix with axe and computed-contrast evidence, importing the runner support from e2e/support/story-174-3-*.ts and test/expect from ./fixtures/network-test.
